chunks: 5632 - Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū ʿUbaydah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

Concerning a man who died and left behind his wife, his sister, and his grandfather, he عليه السلام said: “This is divided into four shares: for the wife is one-fourth, for the sister is one share, and for the grandfather are two shares.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةِ أَسْهُمٍ: four allotted shares of the estate

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided between a wife, sister, and grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance distribution when a deceased man leaves behind a wife, a sister, and a grandfather. The estate is divided into four shares: one for the wife, one for the sister, and two for the grandfather, illustrating the fixed apportionment of heirs in Shia fiqh.
